terms.grammar: genitive plural of vītamīnum, with its noun
terms.comment: Latin says “of vitamins”: no reference work has an adjective. Traupman has the noun vītamīnum (pp. 66, 402) and Morgan–Owens the feminine vitamina (s.v. vitamin); Levi–Bini and Andresian have neither the noun nor an adjective. See vitamin.
A transparent derivative of ours from the noun. No reference work has it, and the genitive does its work.

sources: Morgan–Owens: Adumbratio · Vitaminum: Calepinus Novus attribution
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 66, 402.
